items.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13

ctx.x: And did they have many guitar pickers out there? No, not many. I thought they'd have plenty of guitar pickers. Is that in the Delta or on the edge? That's hills, huh?
Oh no, that's just around there. That's 21 miles east of Matthew.
So that's hills then, huh? Yes, sir. Yes. You have to work hard out there? No, I wouldn't like for nobody. Work for yourself or just not work? Well, didn't work.
